zubenelgenubi.audio_profile: Theo, a fifteen-year-old boy whose voice has only just broken. He has lived alone in a mall's ceiling for four months. Guarded, quick and a little defiant, he talks low and short, like someone used to staying hidden. A real teenager, not an actor.

scene: In a dark, locked store in a mall full of the dead, a runaway teenager talks quietly with the night guard.
sample_context: A runaway teenager talks with the night guard who caught him.

chunks.text: Same song every time. You only know half the words.
chunks.scene: In a dark, locked store in a mall full of the dead, a runaway teenager talks quietly with the night guard.

chunks.text: Don't put your foot where you think the floor is.
chunks.scene: Up in the ceiling over a crowd of the dead, a teenager gives the man beside him short, urgent instructions, keeping his voice down.
